name: detached-triggers-controlled
whatItDemonstrates: Three detached triggers plus a plain button programmatically open one popover whose open state and active trigger are fully controlled from React state.
stateManaged: controlled — useState for `open` (boolean) and `triggerId` (string | null); `onOpenChange` mirrors `eventDetails.trigger?.id ?? null` back into the triggerId state; the programmatic button sets both directly
nonTrivialInteractions: A plain <button> (not a Popover.Trigger) opens the popover programmatically by setting triggerId='trigger-2' and open=true
onOpenChange reads eventDetails.trigger?.id to track which trigger is active and mirrors it back into the controlled triggerId state
Positioner box is frozen to var(--positioner-height)/var(--positioner-width) with max-width var(--available-width), the animation-ready sizing recipe from the docs page

name: detached-triggers-full
whatItDemonstrates: Three detached triggers each pass a different panel component as a typed handle payload, and a single Root renders the active payload inside a Viewport with direction-aware position/size/content animations when switching between triggers.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no app state; per-trigger content comes from the handle payload rendered via the function-as-a-child Root
nonTrivialInteractions: Typed handle Popover.createHandle<React.ComponentType>() carries a distinct component payload per Trigger (NotificationsPanel, ActivityPanel, ProfilePanel)
Function-as-a-child Root receives { payload } and renders it inside Popover.Viewport only when defined
Viewport content transition is keyed off the space-separated data-activation-direction attribute, styling [data-current] and [data-previous] enter/exit states with directional translate/opacity

On trigger switches the Positioner transitions top/left/right/bottom/transform while the Popup transitions width/height/opacity/scale (and the Arrow its left offset); the data-instant attribute disables all transitions for instant repositioning

name: detached-triggers-simple
whatItDemonstrates: A single trigger rendered outside Popover.Root, linked to it by a shared handle created with Popover.createHandle().
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no open-state props; the Root manages open state internally from Trigger interactions
nonTrivialInteractions: Trigger sits outside Popover.Root in the tree; a module-level Popover.createHandle() is passed to both the Trigger and the Root to link them

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: The canonical minimal popover: a trigger button opens a portal-rendered popup anchored 8px below it, containing an arrow, title, and description.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no open-state props; clicking the Trigger toggles the Root's internal open state

name: open-on-hover
whatItDemonstrates: A popover configured to open when the pointer hovers the Trigger instead of on click.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no open-state props; hover-intent open/close timing is handled internally by the component
nonTrivialInteractions: Opens on pointer hover via the openOnHover prop (no explicit delay/closeDelay set, so component defaults apply)
